name: Ash Lowell
descr: Ash Lowell grew up with a clan hidden deep in the forest and trusts their bow more than words. They prefer to act first and sort out the questions afterwards.

features.name: Feline Instincts
features.text: When you make an Agility Roll, you can **spend 2 Hope** to reroll your Hope Die.

features.name: Retracting Claws
features.text: Make an **Agility Roll** to scratch a target within Melee range. On a success, they become temporarily _Vulnerable._

features.name: Lightfoot
features.text: Your movement is naturally silent. You have advantage on rolls to move without being heard.

hopeFeature.name: Hold Them Off
hopeFeature.text: **Spend 3 Hope** when you succeed on an attack with a weapon to use that same roll against two additional adversaries within range of the attack.

features.name: Ranger's Focus
features.text:
**Spend a Hope** and make an attack against a target. On a success, deal your attack's normal damage and temporarily make the attack's target your _Focus_. Until this feature ends or you make a different creature your _Focus_, you gain the following benefits against your _Focus:_

- You know precisely what direction they are in.
- When you deal damage to them, they must mark a Stress.
- When you fail an attack against them, you can end your Ranger's Focus feature to reroll your Duality Dice.

foundations.name: Ruthless Predator
foundations.text: When you make a damage roll, you can **mark a Stress** to gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency. Additionally, when you deal Severe damage to an adversary, they must mark a Stress.

foundations.name: Path Forward
foundations.text: When you're traveling to a place you've previously visited or you carry an object that has been at the location before, you can identify the shortest, most direct path to your destination.

specializations.name: Elusive Predator
specializations.text: When your Focus makes an attack against you, you gain a +2 bonus to your Evasion against the attack.

masteries.name: Apex Predator
masteries.text: Before you make an attack roll against your _Focus_, you can **spend a Hope.** On a successful attack, you remove a Fear from the GM's Fear pool.

inventory.name: First-Kill Trophy
inventory.descr: A curved fang on a leather cord, from the first beast Ash ever brought down.

domainCards.name: Vicious Entangle
domainCards.descr:
Make a **Spellcast Roll** against a target within Far range. On a success, roots and vines reach out from the ground, dealing **1d8+1** physical damage and temporarily _Restraining_ the target.

Additionally on a success, you can **spend a Hope** to temporarily _Restrain_ another adversary within Very Close range of your target.

domainCards.name: Untouchable
domainCards.descr: Gain a bonus to your Evasion equal to half your Agility.

appearance.clothes: Mossy greens and browns that blend into the trees
appearance.skin: Soft grey fur striped with black

data.background: Ash was raised among the treetop villages of a secretive forest clan, where they learned to read every broken twig and bent blade of grass. For years they have tracked a strange beast that no one else believes exists, and every new forest might be the one where they finally find it.
